What are the types of Security Testing? Answer: Vulnerability Assessment (VA) Penetration Testing (PT) Automated Security Testing Tools Code Review (performed in a test environment) What are the types of activities performed during Security Engineering? Answer: Firewall Access Control Lists (ACLs) Creating DMZ Architecture Network Segmentation using VLANs Adding Security Tools (SIEM, Firewall, DLP, NAC) Application and Database Encryption In the QualysGuard scanning methodology, once TCP port scanning has been completed, which detection test is performed next? Answer: Operating System (OS) Detection After TCP port scanning, Qualys performs OS Detection by sending specially crafted packets to open and closed ports to identify the operating system of the target machine.
